method: Actual local app in headless Chromium with a temporary persistent unauthenticated profile and real service worker; no network route mocks or synthetic install events. The profile is deleted when the browser closes.

checks.name: public service worker and manifest MIME/update headers
actual application provider registers and controls the application origin
manifest identity, scope and decoded installation icon dimensions
actual CacheStorage contains exactly the public allowlist after API, framework-data and query probes
online private navigation keeps the actual authentication redirect and adds no cached document
offline document navigation receives only the generic fallback; API fetch fails and cache stays public-only
reconnect retry reloads the original route and restores the server authentication flow

screenshots.review: Saved image inspected: readable content, visible retry control, no clipping or horizontal overflow.
Saved image inspected: readable content, visible retry control, no clipping or horizontal overflow.

limitations: Headless Chromium and viewport emulation do not verify OS-level installation, iOS Safari, native apps, or a physical mobile device.
Tests use an unauthenticated browser and public/local probe requests; authenticated authorization and tenant isolation are outside this check.
CDP installability diagnostics describe this tested origin and browser session only.

installPromptObservation.reason: No natural beforeinstallprompt event was emitted during this headless session. CDP installability errors were empty; no synthetic install event or OS installation was performed.
